_about: The gate's fixture set: one clean item of the invented brand Acme and its mutations, each with the check and verdict it must produce. Every name, handle, theme and claim id resolves inside tests/fixtures/memory/, never in .atelier/memory/. The status-word cases ship empty with gate_lint.STATUS_WORDS: a brand adds a blocking case per rule beside its rules (TEMPLATE-CONTRACT.md). Written 2026-11-05.

base.title: A wallet holds a credential. It does not decide which root issued it.
base.post:
Europe is building wallets. Every member state owes its citizens one, and the engineering is well under way.

The question underneath the programme is quieter. A wallet holds credentials; it does not establish which root a company credential chains to. That is a governance decision, taken once, and it decides whether a credential is portable across borders or merely valid at home.

We would argue the root is the interesting part. An identifier governed by a public standard, issued under a published qualification regime, checkable by the party relying on it: that is a different object from a national register with an API.

What we do not claim: no wallet obligation or standard named here requires the identifier we work with, and nothing in this post asserts a deployed Acme capability.
base.teaser_linkedin:
A wallet holds a credential. It does not decide which root issued it.

The wallet programme is engineering. The root a company credential chains to is governance, and it is still open. That choice decides whether the credential is portable or merely valid at home.
